sloka: यथा त्वयि अंगदो नित्यम् वर्तते वानरेश्वरः ।तथा वर्तते सुग्रीवो मयि च अपि न संशयः ॥४-१८-६४॥
transliteration: yathā tvayi aṁgado nityam vartate vānareśvaraḥ ।tathā vartate sugrīvo mayi ca api na saṁśayaḥ ॥4-18-64॥

translations.english: 'You have been purged of your sin through punishment from the point of view of righteousness. You have regained your spiritual nature on the path of dharma.
